claim.claim-text: 2. The gun light according to claim 1, wherein the fixing mechanism further comprises an adjusting component, and the adjusting component comprises an adjusting slider and an adjusting rod, the adjusting slider is slidably fitted with the housing, the adjusting rod is provide on the adjusting slider, the adjusting rod is located at a top of the locking elastic sheet, the adjusting slider is slid in a direction close to or away from the light-emitting module, so that the adjusting rod is located at a top of different positions of the locking elastic sheet.

3. The gun light according to claim 2, wherein the adjusting slider comprises a first sliding part and a second sliding part, the housing is provided with a sliding groove that is penetrated along a length direction, the second sliding part is penetrated and is slidably fitted to the sliding groove, the adjusting rod is engraved with threads; the adjusting rod is penetrated through the first sliding part, and the adjusting rod is threaded connected to the second sliding part, so that when the adjusting rod is rotated, the second sliding part is moved towards or away from the first sliding part.

4. The gun light according to claim 3, wherein a bottom of the first sliding part is engraved with a friction protrusion, and the housing is engraved with a friction recess, the friction protrusion and the friction recess are in contact and cooperate.

6. The gun light according to claim 1, wherein the fixing mechanism further comprises a connecting component, and the connecting component comprises a connecting rod, a connecting block, a connecting nut, and an adjusting handle, the connecting rod is provided on the housing, and the connecting rod is slid in a width direction, the connecting block is slidably fitted with the housing in the width direction, the connecting nut is threaded connected to one end of the connecting rod and abuts against the connecting block, and the adjusting handle is rotatably connected to the other end of the connecting rod.

7. The gun light according to claim 6, wherein the connecting rod comprises a first rod body and a second rod body, the first rod body is penetrated into an interior of the second rod body and is slidably fitted with the second rod body, the first rod body is fixedly connected with an adjusting protrusion, and an interior of the second rod body is fixedly provided with a plurality of contact protrusions, the contact protrusions are distributed along a length direction of the second rod body; the adjusting protrusion abut against the contact protrusions, and positions of the first rod body and the second rod body are relatively fixed.
8. The gun light according to claim 7, wherein the connecting nut is fixedly provided with an easy-to-twist block.

9. The gun light according to claim 6, wherein the contact protrusions are provided with a clamping groove, and when the adjusting protrusion is inserted into the clamping groove, the first rod body and the second rod body are not easily rotated relative to each other.
